 1          Plaintiff Meta Platforms, Inc. (“Meta”) respectfully requests the Court continue the

 2 upcoming Case Management Conference and ADR Deadlines set forth in the Court’s Order, Dkt.

 3 9, for two months.

 4          Meta filed its lawsuit against Defendants Judang Team LLC, Perfeos LLC d/b/a Shop at

 5 Mars, Jot & Journeys aka Jot & Journey, and Antonio Lievano (collectively, the “Defendants”)

 6 on June 18 2025. Since that time, Meta has been diligently attempting to serve the Defendants,

 7 utilizing all available information. Despite these extensive efforts, those attempts have not been

 8 successful.

 9          Meta requested an initial summons based on the last known addresses for the Defendants,

10 which included the addresses currently listed on the Defendants’ websites and those that

11 Defendants previously provided to Meta. Those service attempts, however, were unsuccessful.

12 Meta has since twice requested an amended summons, based on new information providing

13 additional possible addresses for service. For more details of the efforts undertaken to achieve

14 service, please see the accompanying Declaration of Jessica I. Rothschild. Given the difficulties

15 in serving the Defendants, Meta anticipates that it will be filing a motion to serve process by

16 alternative means and for extension of time for service of process.

17          This is the first request for an extension of case deadlines. Meta has not been able to

18 serve the Defendants despite its reasonable efforts and, therefore, has been unable to discuss with

19 the Defendants a stipulation for the relief requested in this Motion. Because the Defendants have

20 not been located and served, if the deadlines are not extended, Meta cannot meet the Court-

21 ordered deadlines to meet and confer with the Defendants. As these are the initial case

22 deadlines, the overall case schedule will not be negatively affected by an extension.

23          Because of the difficulties in serving the Defendants and because Meta is preparing a

24 motion to serve process by alternative means and for extension of time for service of process,

25 Meta respectfully requests a two month extension of the upcoming Case Management

26 Conference and ADR Deadlines.

27
